page.overview:
Who is Big the Cat?

Big the Cat is a character from the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise. He made his first overall appearance in Sonic Adventure, but Big's first Mario-related appearance is in the Wii version of Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games.

Big the Cat appears as a referee for the Athletics and Rowing events. He can also be seen behind the podium in the Athletics events during the awards ceremony.

Big the Cat appears as a VIP Member, and along with Birdo is the only character to give the player a costume as well as 100 Star Points. There is also an unlockable Mii costume of Big the Cat.

Big plays a role in Adventure Tours, where he can be found in Polastraits. Here, Big wonders what is the "sign" near him. Amy tries to explain to Big that each mission's details is written there, although because Big does not understand. When Amy completes Big's mission, taking place in Alpine Skiing GS, he understands what Amy was trying to tell him, and rewards the party with a Spark Luge.
